azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerLog
| join kind = inner
    (
        ContainerInventory
        | where Image has "${am_image_name}"
        | distinct ContainerID , pod = ContainerHostname
    ) on ContainerID
| project TimeGenerated ,  LogEntry, pod
| where LogEntry != ""
| where LogEntry has ("${log_message_filter}") or "" == "$log_message_filter"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500

ContainerLog
| join kind = inner
    (
        ContainerInventory
        | where Image has "${am_image_name}"
        | distinct ContainerID , pod = ContainerHostname
    ) on ContainerID
| project TimeGenerated ,  LogEntry, pod
| where LogEntry != ""
| where LogEntry has ("${log_message_filter}") or "" == "$log_message_filter"
| summarize LogCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) 
| order by TimeGenerated asc
